messages:
maria: @oncall-bot alerts: gpu-uw5-03 is flapping, 3 containers OOM in last 10m. CUDA driver msgs repeating, backlog spiking on us-west-2 pool.

oncall-bot: INCIDENT 6288881234 created (sev2) — high OOM / CUDA errors in us-west-2. Paging: eng-oncall.

jin: On it. Can someone grab the alloc log and `nvidia-smi` output for the node? Also paste `redwood-agent` heap stats.

maria: pastelog: see snippet below
```
[2026-03-17T02:34:11Z] allocator: total_bytes=16384MB used=15520MB free_fragments=48321 avg_frag=64B paged_chunks=1289
[2026-03-17T02:34:14Z] kvcache: resident=12.1GB pages=10234 evict_candidates=0
[2026-03-17T02:34:18Z] cuda: driver_err=UNKNOWN_ERROR code=700
```

arnold: Looks like classic slow-fragmentation in the paged-attention allocator — tons of tiny free fragments, eviction not reclaiming. Might be KV cache pinned objects + prefix growth.

jin: Agreed. This matches a creeping leak pattern. Immediate mitigations:
- reduce batch target to 1 for the affected pool
- temporarily disable paged-attention on pool `us-west-2-gpu-pool-3` (fall back to non-paged path)
- trigger targeted rolling restart of containers on gpu-uw5-03

maria: customer impact — two customers (acct: alpha-ops, bearer-analytics) seeing 5-15% 500s and 8-12s tail latency on generation. Some requests hitting OOM retry.

ops-bot: rolling-restart initiated for pool us-west-2-gpu-pool-3 (targeting nodes: gpu-uw5-03,gpu-uw5-04). ETA ~6m.

jin: While restarts happen, increase KV eviction aggressiveness on that pool: `REDWOOD_KV_EVICT_THRESHOLD=0.60 -> 0.45` (temporary). Also enable `REDWOOD_PAGED_ATTENTION=false` for the pool config.

arnold: Patch suggestion (short-term): bump `paged-allocator.min_slab_size` to reduce micro-frag, and force a slab compaction run: `curl -XPOST https://infra-api/pools/us-west-2/compact`

maria: I ran compact and set evict threshold to 0.45 on the pool. Restart log: ops-bot reports one node timed out and was retried, other nodes came up.

ops-bot: restart complete: 6/8 containers restarted, 2 retried. Node gpu-uw5-03 still showing transient driver messages; escalated to eng-infra.

jin: Good. Monitoring now — check latency/error dashboards. If errors drop below 1% and no OOMs in 15m, we can keep current mitigations and plan a staged config fix.

maria: Post-mit status at +12m: errors down to 3%, OOMs stopped on restarted nodes, but one node shows slow memory creep on KV cache (gpu-uw5-05).

arnold: We should schedule an offline replacement of the paged-attn allocator on that image and add an eviction path that can reclaim pinned kv entries faster. I'll open a PR for an opt-in patch.

leo: Taking handoff for monitoring window. Summary for next shift: Sev2 on us-west-2 due to paged-attention allocator fragmentation causing slow memory creep -> OOMs on a few nodes. Temporary mitigations applied: reduced batch size, disabled paged-attention on pool, lowered KV evict threshold, compact run, rolling restart. Customer impact: 2 customers, tail latency 8-12s briefly, ~10% error peak. Next actions: watch 30m, confirm no OOMs, coordinate infra on driver flakiness.

sara: I'll own the postmortem and follow-up action items: assign eng-infra to driver flakiness, eng-runtime to allocator compaction and eviction improvements, product to notify affected customers.

maria: Thanks — CC'ing @sara. I'll update the incident ticket with logs + commands we ran. :thumbsup:

leo: Starting watch. Ping me in-channel if anything spikes.

oncall-bot: INCIDENT 6288881234 updated — mitigations in place. Watch status: active. Assigned: sara for postmortem, leo on watch.

sara: Created internal postmortem draft: https://redwood-internal/pm/6288881234 — filling in timeline and owner sections.

leo: Handoff complete at 02:59 UTC.

maria: closing active mitigations ticket; we'll keep follow-ups in the postmortem.
